title: Hamster dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#f7d08a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='22' r='8' fill='#d4792a'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='22' r='4' fill='#f7b0b0'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='22' r='8' fill='#d4792a'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='22' r='4' fill='#f7b0b0'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='6' fill='#f7a8a8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='6' fill='#f7a8a8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#d4792a'/>
  <path d='M46 47 Q50 50 54 47' stroke='#d4792a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- buck teeth -->
  <rect x='48' y='47' width='2' height='4' rx='0.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='50' y='47' width='2' height='4' rx='0.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- dancing arm left (up) -->
  <path d='M28 55 Q18 42 22 34' stroke='#e8a33d' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left paw -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='33' r='5' fill='#f7d08a'/>
  <!-- dancing arm right (out) -->
  <path d='M72 58 Q84 50 86 42' stroke='#e8a33d' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right paw -->
  <circle cx='87' cy='41' r='5' fill='#f7d08a'/>
  <!-- leg left -->
  <path d='M38 80 Q34 90 30 92' stroke='#e8a33d' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- foot left -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f7d08a'/>
  <!-- leg right (kicking up) -->
  <path d='M62 80 Q70 88 76 86' stroke='#e8a33d' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- foot right -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='85' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f7d08a' transform='rotate(-20 78 85)'/>
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <g fill='#8be0ff'>
    <ellipse cx='18' cy='20' rx='4' ry='3'/>
    <rect x='21' y='10' width='1.8' height='10'/>
    <path d='M21 10 Q27 8 27 13' stroke='#8be0ff' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none'/>
    <ellipse cx='82' cy='16' rx='3.5' ry='2.5'/>
    <rect x='84.5' y='7' width='1.5' height='9'/>
    <path d='M84.5 7 Q90 5 90 10' stroke='#8be0ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <path d='M12 48 l2 4 l4 2 l-4 2 l-2 4 l-2 -4 l-4 -2 l4 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M88 65 l1.5 3 l3 1.5 l-3 1.5 l-1.5 3 l-1.5 -3 l-3 -1.5 l3 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M50 8 l1.5 3 l3 1.5 l-3 1.5 l-1.5 3 l-1.5 -3 l-3 -1.5 l3 -1.5 z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
